question_patterns: who is allowed in the library
is the library open to everyone
answer: All registered students, academic and non-academic staff can use the library. External researchers and visitors may also use the library but require special approval and may need to pay a fee.

question_patterns: what do i need to enter the library
can i enter without id card
do i need an id to use the library
answer: You need a valid University ID card or proof of registration (such as a school charges receipt) to enter the library.

question_patterns: what are the library opening hours
what time does the library open
is the library open on weekends
is the library open on saturday
is the library open on sunday
answer: The library is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Saturday hours vary by branch — please check with your specific branch. The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question_patterns: how do i borrow a book
answer: To borrow a book, bring it to the circulation desk along with your University ID card and your borrower's ticket. Library staff will process the loan for you.

question_patterns: how many books can i borrow
how many books can i take
answer: Undergraduates may borrow up to 2 books for 2 weeks. Postgraduates may borrow up to 4 books for 1 month. Staff may borrow up to 5 books for 1 month.

question_patterns: how do i return a book
answer: Bring the book(s) to the circulation desk and library staff will process the return for you.

question_patterns: how do i renew library books
answer: Books can be renewed at the circulation desk if they have not been requested by another user.

question_patterns: what happens if i return a book late
what is the fine for late return
how much is the library fine
answer: Late returns attract fines and may result in the suspension of your borrowing privileges. The fine amount depends on how many days overdue the book is. Please ask at the circulation desk for the current fine rates.

question_patterns: is there wifi in the library
can i use internet in the library
answer: Yes. The UNIJOS-Hotspot Wi-Fi network is available for students and staff within the library premises.

question_patterns: how do i access online resources
how do i access library online resources
answer: Yes. The library provides access to electronic resources including e-books and academic journals through the university library website. Ask a librarian if you need help getting started.
Past student projects, dissertations, and theses are available for reading within the library only and cannot be borrowed or taken out.

question_patterns: can i eat in the library
can i use my phone in the library
am i allowed to eat in the library
is eating allowed in the library
answer: Library users are expected to maintain silence at all times, avoid eating or drinking inside the library, keep mobile phones on silent mode, and not reserve seats for others.

question_patterns: is there photocopying in the library
answer: Yes. Photocopying services are available in the library, subject to copyright regulations.

question_patterns: how do i get help in the library
who can help me in the library
who do i contact in the library
answer: You can approach any library staff member or visit the circulation desk for assistance. Librarians are available to help you find resources, use the catalogue, and answer any questions.

answer: You can search for books using the library catalogue by title, author, or subject. Note the call number from the catalogue and use it to navigate to the correct shelf. You can also ask a librarian for assistance.

answer: Library registration is done using your student or staff ID. Visit the library or the circulation desk to complete registration and obtain your borrower's ticket. You must be registered or have valid identification to access the library.

answer: Report the lost book to the circulation desk as soon as possible. You may be required to replace the book or pay the cost of replacement.
